    <DataSource>{"DefinitionId":"SqlQuery","Parameters":{"DbConnector":{"Type":"Database","Group":"","EntireGroup":false},"ConnectionString":"","QueryTimeout":"","SqlQuery":";WITH Parametri AS 
( SELECT [Initializari:ZileLucratoare_old(Anul = [GetOrSession:YearV],Luna = [GetOrSession:MonthV])] AS ZileLucratoare )
SELECT
    a.Id,
    a.Marca,
    a.Nume,
    b.Salariu,
    a.TipNorma,

    p.ZileLucratoare,
    ISNULL(co.ZileCOLuna, 0) AS ZileCOLuna,
    ISNULL(cm.ZileCMLuna, 0) AS ZileCMLuna,

    zl.ZileLucrate,

    -- venituri suplimentare
    ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)    AS SumaAgent,
    ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0) AS Sume_Remiza,

    -- placeholder momentan
    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Sume_AlteDrepturi,
    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Sume_CAR,
    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Sume_Pensii_Alim,
    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Sume_Pensii_Facultative,

    -- calcule
    ca.OreLucrate,
    ca.SalBrutEfectiv,
    ca.TicheteTotale,
    ca.TotalBrut,
    ca.CAS,
    ca.CASS,
    ca.VenitNet,
    ca.BazaImpozabila,
    ca.ImpozitVenit,
    ca.SalariuNet

FROM app.Salariat a

LEFT JOIN app.NomGrilaSalarizare b
       ON b.Clasa   = a.Clasa
      AND b.TipMediu = 'U'

LEFT JOIN app.TSTichetMasa t
       ON t.Anul = a.Anul
      AND t.Luna = a.Luna

CROSS JOIN Parametri p

-----------------------------------------------------------
-- CO
-----------------------------------------------------------
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN MONTH(c.Interval1DatadeInceput)=@Luna
              AND YEAR(c.Interval1DatadeInceput)=@Anul
                 THEN ISNULL(c.NrZileCO1,0) ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN MONTH(c.Interval2DatadeInceput)=@Luna
              AND YEAR(c.Interval2DatadeInceput)=@Anul
                 THEN ISNULL(c.NrZileCO2,0) ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN MONTH(c.Interval3DatadeInceput)=@Luna
              AND YEAR(c.Interval3DatadeInceput)=@Anul
                 THEN ISNULL(c.NrZileCO3,0) ELSE 0 END
        ) AS ZileCOLuna
    FROM app.ConcediudeOdihna c
    WHERE c.Marca        = a.Marca
      AND c.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
) co

-----------------------------------------------------------
-- CM
-----------------------------------------------------------
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT
        SUM(m.TotZileLucratoare) AS ZileCMLuna
    FROM app.ConcediuMedical m
    WHERE m.Marca        = a.Marca
      AND m.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
      AND m.AnulDePlata  = @Anul
      AND m.LunaDePlata  = @Luna
) cm

-----------------------------------------------------------
-- Zile lucrate
-----------------------------------------------------------
CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN p.ZileLucratoare
                 - ISNULL(co.ZileCOLuna,0)
                 - ISNULL(cm.ZileCMLuna,0) &lt; 0
            THEN 0
            ELSE p.ZileLucratoare
                 - ISNULL(co.ZileCOLuna,0)
                 - ISNULL(cm.ZileCMLuna,0)
        END AS ZileLucrate
) zl

-----------------------------------------------------------
-- Suma Agent (contributivă)
-----------------------------------------------------------
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT 
        SUM(ISNULL(ca2.Suma,0)) AS SumaAgent
    FROM app.CalculAgent ca2
    WHERE ca2.Marca        = a.Marca
      AND ca2.Anul    = @Anul
      AND ca2.Luna  = @Luna
      AND ca2.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
) ag
-----------------------------------------------------------
-- Suma Remiza (contributivă)
-----------------------------------------------------------
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT SUM(ISNULL(x.Suma,0)) AS Sume_Remiza
    FROM app.Remiza x
    WHERE x.Marca        = a.Marca
      AND x.Anul        = @Anul
      AND x.Luna        = @Luna
      AND x.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
) rem
-----------------------------------------------------------
-- Blocuri placeholder (valoare 0)
-----------------------------------------------------------
--OUTER APPLY (SELECT CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Sume_Remiza) rem
OUTER APPLY (SELECT CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Sume_CAR) car
OUTER APPLY (SELECT CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Sume_AlteDrepturi) ad
OUTER APPLY (SELECT CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Sume_Pensii_Alim) pa
OUTER APPLY (SELECT CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Sume_Pensii_Facultative) pf

-----------------------------------------------------------
-- Calcule financiare
-----------------------------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------------------------
-- Calcule financiare corecte
-----------------------------------------------------------
CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT

        -----------------------------------------
        -- Ore lucrate
        -----------------------------------------
        zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8 AS OreLucrate,

        -----------------------------------------
        -- Brut proporțional
        -----------------------------------------
        ROUND(
            (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
            * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
            0
        ) AS SalBrutEfectiv,

        -----------------------------------------
        -- Tichete
        -----------------------------------------
        ISNULL(t.Valoare,0) * zl.ZileLucrate AS TicheteTotale,

        -----------------------------------------
        -- Brut contributiv real
        -----------------------------------------
        (
            ROUND(
                (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                0
            )
            + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
            + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
        ) AS BrutContributiv,

        -----------------------------------------
        -- Total brut (include tichete)
        -----------------------------------------
        (
            ROUND(
                (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                0
            )
            + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
            + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
            + (ISNULL(t.Valoare,0) * zl.ZileLucrate)
        ) AS TotalBrut,

        -----------------------------------------
        -- CAS
        -----------------------------------------
        ROUND(
            (
                ROUND(
                    (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                    * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                    0
                )
                + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
                + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
            ) * 0.25,
            0
        ) AS CAS,

        -----------------------------------------
        -- CASS
        -----------------------------------------
        ROUND(
            (
                ROUND(
                    (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                    * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                    0
                )
                + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
                + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
                + (ISNULL(t.Valoare,0) * zl.ZileLucrate)
            ) * 0.10,
            0
        ) AS CASS,

        -----------------------------------------
        -- Venit net
        -----------------------------------------
        (
            (
                ROUND(
                    (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                    * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                    0
                )
                + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
                + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
                + (ISNULL(t.Valoare,0) * zl.ZileLucrate)
            )
            - ROUND(
                (
                    ROUND(
                        (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                        * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                        0
                    )
                    + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
                    + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
                ) * 0.25,
                0
            )
            - ROUND(
                (
                    ROUND(
                        (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                        * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                        0
                    )
                    + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
                    + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
                    + (ISNULL(t.Valoare,0) * zl.ZileLucrate)
                ) * 0.10,
                0
            )
        ) AS VenitNet,

        -----------------------------------------
        -- Baza impozabilă REALĂ
        -----------------------------------------
        (
            (
                ROUND(
                    (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                    * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                    0
                )
                + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
                + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
            )
            - ROUND(
                (
                    ROUND(
                        (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                        * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                        0
                    )
                    + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
                    + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
                ) * 0.25,
                0
            )
            - ROUND(
                (
                    ROUND(
                        (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                        * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                        0
                    )
                    + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
                    + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
                ) * 0.10,
                0
            )
        ) AS BazaImpozabila,

        -----------------------------------------
        -- Impozit real
        -----------------------------------------
        ROUND(
            (
                (
                    (
                        ROUND(
                            (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                            * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                            0
                        )
                        + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
                        + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
                    )
                    - ROUND(
                        (
                            ROUND(
                                (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                                * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                                0
                            )
                            + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
                            + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
                        ) * 0.25,
                        0
                    )
                    - ROUND(
                        (
                            ROUND(
                                (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                                * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                                0
                            )
                            + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
                            + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
                        ) * 0.10,
                        0
                    )
                ) * 0.10
            ),
            0
        ) AS ImpozitVenit,

        -----------------------------------------
        -- Salariu net final real
        -----------------------------------------
        (
            (
                (
                    ROUND(
                        (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                        * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                        0
                    )
                    + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
                    + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
                )
                - ROUND(
                    (
                        ROUND(
                            (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                            * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                            0
                        )
                        + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
                        + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
                    ) * 0.25,
                    0
                )
                - ROUND(
                    (
                        ROUND(
                            (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                            * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                            0
                        )
                        + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
                        + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
                    ) * 0.10,
                    0
                )
            )
            - ROUND(
                (
                    (
                        ROUND(
                            (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                            * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                            0
                        )
                        + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
                        + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
                    )
                    - ROUND(
                        (
                            ROUND(
                                (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                                * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                                0
                            )
                            + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
                            + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
                        ) * 0.25,
                        0
                    )
                    - ROUND(
                        (
                            ROUND(
                                (b.Salariu / (p.ZileLucratoare * 8))
                                * (zl.ZileLucrate * a.TipNorma * 8),
                                0
                            )
                            + ISNULL(ag.SumaAgent,0)
                            + ISNULL(rem.Sume_Remiza,0)
                        ) * 0.10,
                        0
                    )
                ) * 0.10,
                0
            )
        ) AS SalariuNet

) ca
WHERE 
a.Anul = @Anul 
AND a.Luna = @Luna 
AND a.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala 
ORDER BY a.Marca, a.Nume;
